name: mqsc-lsp-vscode
description: IBM MQ MQSC script support — diagnostics, completion, navigation and quickfixes via the mqsc-lsp server (tree-sitter based). Requires the mqsc-lsp binary.

mqsc.server.path.markdownDescription: Command or absolute path of the `mqsc-lsp` binary. Left at the default `mqsc-lsp`, the extension finds the binary on `PATH` first, then in the common release install directories (`~/.local/bin`, `/usr/local/bin`, `/opt/homebrew/bin`, `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\mqsc-lsp`); if nothing is found it links to the GitHub Releases page instead of failing silently. Set it to a build (`cargo build --release` in the `server` directory) or an extracted release download to override the search.

mqsc.server.logFile.markdownDescription: Optional file for server diagnostics (request timings, parse/analyze durations, panics). Passed to the server as `MQSC_LSP_LOG`. Empty = no logging.

mqsc.targetVersion.markdownDescription: MQ version the scripts target, e.g. `9.4` (major or `major.minor`; a patch level is read as its minor release). Enables diagnostic 15 NOT_IN_TARGET for parameters newer than this release. Empty = no version checks.

mqsc.platform.markdownDescription: Platform the scripts target. Enables diagnostic 15 NOT_IN_TARGET for parameters that only exist on the other platform (e.g. `BOQNAME` is z/OS-only). Empty = no platform checks.

mqsc.crossFileNavigation.markdownDescription: Let **Go to Definition** and **Rename Symbol** reach every indexed document (open editors and scanned workspace files). Default `false`: both stay inside the file being edited, so a rename never mass-edits files you have not opened. References, hover, completion, and the undefined-object hint (12) always see the whole workspace regardless. Takes effect immediately.

mqsc.workspaceIndex.enabled.markdownDescription: Index the workspace's closed `*.mqsc` files at startup and keep them current via a file watcher the server registers, so names they `DEFINE` resolve in the files you have open (hint 12, hover, definition, references, completion, rename, workspace/symbol). Takes effect on restart.

mqsc.workspaceIndex.maxFiles.markdownDescription: Maximum number of workspace files to index (files are taken in sorted order). The server warns in the output channel when it had to leave files out. Takes effect on restart.

mqsc.workspaceIndex.exclude.markdownDescription: Directory **names** skipped at any depth while scanning the workspace and while reindexing watched file events. Takes effect on restart.

mqsc.diagnostics.PARSE_ERROR.description: Severity for code 1: syntax error reported by the parser.

mqsc.diagnostics.UNKNOWN_VERB.description: Severity for code 2: the command verb is not a known MQSC verb.

mqsc.diagnostics.UNKNOWN_OBJECT.description: Severity for code 3: the object type does not exist for this verb.

mqsc.diagnostics.UNKNOWN_PARAM.description: Severity for code 4: parameter not defined for this command.

mqsc.diagnostics.BAD_VALUE.description: Severity for code 5: value outside the modelled range/enum.

mqsc.diagnostics.DUPLICATE_PARAM.description: Severity for code 6: parameter given twice in one command.

mqsc.diagnostics.MISSING_CONTINUATION.description: Severity for code 7: command looks truncated — a continuation '+' is probably missing, or the file ends right after a '+'/'-' continuation marker.

mqsc.diagnostics.LEXICAL.description: Severity for code 8: lexical problem (e.g. unterminated quoted string).

mqsc.diagnostics.MISSING_REQUIRED.description: Severity for code 9: required parameter missing.

mqsc.diagnostics.MISSING_NAME.description: Severity for code 10: the object name group is missing.

mqsc.diagnostics.WILDCARD.description: Severity for code 11: wildcard used where a plain name is required.

mqsc.diagnostics.UNDEFINED_OBJECT.description: Severity for code 12: name is never DEFINEd in this script (default: hint).

mqsc.diagnostics.NAME_TOO_LONG.description: Severity for code 13: DEFINE/ALTER/DELETE object name exceeds its maximum length (queues 48 chars, channels 1024; only for object types with a known limit).

mqsc.diagnostics.MISSING_MANDATORY.description: Severity for code 14: DEFINE missing a mandatory property (QALIAS TARGET, QREMOTE RNAME/RQMNAME, CHANNEL CHLTYPE and XMITQ for SDR/SVR, TOPIC TOPICSTR, SUB topic/DEST, BUFFPOOL BUFFERS).

mqsc.diagnostics.NOT_IN_TARGET.description: Severity for code 15: parameter not available for the configured mqsc.targetVersion / mqsc.platform (curated availability; never fires when no target is configured).
